segments.caption: A static, intricate sculpture made of wooden toothpicks with red heads is displayed against a plain white background, remaining completely still across all frames.
A tall, spiral structure made of unlit matches is ignited from the top, causing flames to rapidly spread downward and engulf the entire tower in a bright, intense fire.

A tall, spiraling tower of matchsticks ignites and burns intensely, with flames rapidly consuming the structure from top to bottom, casting a warm, flickering glow on the surrounding surface as the fire grows more vigorous and widespread.
A spiral structure made of sticks or matchsticks is engulfed in bright, dancing flames, burning steadily as it stands upright against a warm, dimly lit background.
A tall, spiraling tower of matches is engulfed in flames, burning intensely as the fire dances and flickers around its structure, illuminating the scene with a warm, orange glow.

A tall, spiraling structure made of matchsticks is engulfed in flames, burning intensely from the bottom up as the fire consumes the wooden sticks, sending up bright, flickering flames and smoke against a plain, dimly lit background.
A fire rapidly grows and spreads across a pile of matches on a floor, with flames rising and engulfing the matchsticks, illuminating the surrounding area with an orange glow.

A small, intense fire burns vigorously on a dark surface, its bright yellow and orange flames dancing and flickering as they consume a pile of what appear to be burnt matchsticks or similar combustible material. The scene is bathed in the warm, orange glow of the fire, with the background wall softly illuminated, highlighting the dynamic, ever-changing shape of the flames as they rise and sway.
